nodes.title: The whole super-admin surface is silently unscanned — no system_admin block means the HAR replay fallback never fires (0 of 16 endpoints, incl. KS-694's GDPR routes)
nodes.description:
## BLUF

Every **super-admin-only** endpoint is invisible to Akto on a stock local checkout, and nothing says so. `config/secrets.yml` carries no `system_admin` block — `config/secrets.example.yml` documents one — so `resolveReplayTokens()` returns `adminToken: null`, the issuer→admin fallback never fires, and each endpoint `ISSUER_ADMIN` cannot get a 2xx from stays a spec-imported placeholder (`responseCode: -1`) that `api_selection_filters` excludes from **every** BOLA/BFLA/authz template.

The bias is the problem: the endpoints that are hardest to authenticate to are the privileged ones, so the harness systematically skips the surface where an authz defect matters most — and reports green.

## Measured — 2026-08-29, local slot-1 stack, Akto 2.22.2

```
collection 56068490 "OpenAPI Secuura API": 323 endpoints
  absolute (scannable)  : 307
  relative (unscannable):  16

endpoints scanned, BOLA run:
  relative : 0 / 16
  absolute : 46 / 80 sampled     <-- discriminating control
```

The 16 that never get scanned:

```
/api/admin/audit/export      /api/analytics/activity        /api/analytics/certifications
/api/analytics/governance    /api/analytics/overview        /api/analytics/revenue
/api/analytics/users         /api/analytics/verifications   /api/audit-log
/api/billing/customers/by-email  /api/gdpr/consent/check    /api/gdpr/deletion-log
/api/m365/callback           /api/oauth/authorize           /api/onedrive/files
/api/system-errors
```

The 7 `analytics` paths are excluded on purpose (`VOLATILE_PATH_RE`, KS-357). **The other 9 are not excluded by anything — they are simply unreachable by the replay persona.** They include `/api/gdpr/deletion-log`, `/api/gdpr/consent/check` and `/api/system-errors` — the exact routes **KS-694 (Urgent)** just put a role gate on, and `/api/oauth/authorize`.

Note the tell: an unscannable entry is stored as a bare path (`/api/audit-log` — the tenant-provisioning upstream path) while a scanned one is a full gateway URL (`http://localhost:6882/api/documents`). That difference is a cheap, reliable detector.

## Proof of causation

Adding the documented `system_admin` block to local `secrets.yml` (gitignored; seeded `admin@secuura.com`, per `secrets.example.yml`):

```
captured 2xx samples : 71 → 79
audit-log in api_info: /api/audit-log  →  http://localhost:6882/api/platform/audit-log
ADD_USER_ID on it    : 0 rows → 1 row
```

That change is what made **KS-708** reproducible at all. Before it, `ADD_USER_ID` reported *"188 tested, 0 vulnerable"* while never touching the endpoint under investigation.

## The documentation understates it

`secrets.example.yml:30-34` says `system_admin` is *"optional. Only needed to seed the locked-account test-role… Absent ⇒ that one role is skipped (best-effort), and* `AUTH_BYPASS_LOCKED_ACCOUNT_TOKEN_ROLE` *keeps skipping honestly."*

That is not the whole consequence. Absent, it also removes the entire super-admin surface from HAR replay, and therefore from every similarity-based authz template. Nobody reading that comment would expect it.

## Suggested shape

1. **Warn loudly when** `adminToken` **is null** — name the count of endpoints that will consequently have no 2xx sample. Silence is the actual defect; a skipped endpoint should never be indistinguishable from a clean one (the KS-700 / KS-709 principle, applied to coverage rather than results).
2. Correct the `secrets.example.yml` comment to state the coverage consequence.
3. Consider failing `test:setup` when the block is absent, or defaulting it to the seeded local admin.

## Done means

1. A run without a system-admin token says so, with the affected endpoint count.
2. `secrets.example.yml` states the real consequence.
3. The relative-vs-absolute URL split is asserted somewhere, so this cannot silently regress.
